title: Fix Textualize/textual#6706: ZeroDivisionError parsing pixel mouse events when terminal pixel size is (0, 0)
description:

Source issue: https://github.com/Textualize/textual/issues/6706
Target repository: https://github.com/Textualize/textual

Scope:
